Failed capture or composition leaves committed evidence unchanged, while attempted work stays charged. Aborting either an active or sealed arena prevents future data reads and exports, including a final iterator pull. Exported immutable observations from before abort are historical values. These are ordinary-Python ownership guarantees under the stated assumptions, not a hostile-code sandbox.

Both new streams use explicit iterator state machines. Consumers must check the explicit completion flag after comparing every byte; the last byte alone does not certify successful completion. Separate finite diagnostics cover abort, rollback, cache fallbacks, typed values, catalogue coverage, scalar boundaries and selected delegated exceptions.

Returned diagnostic fragment_repeated_subtree_and_summary: \(4\) typed nodes, \(5\) references, \(10\) ordinary value occurrences, \(61\) canonical body bytes and \(3\) stream cache hits. The complete input, wire table and independent counters can be inspected in the selector.

The reference graph, when available, comes from the actual ordinary-data diagnostic. It is not a Wang tiling or a discovered lemma. Colors distinguish reference roles, not learned GCTS markings.

The independent inverse is separately authored and imports no encoder code. It validates the complete node table and emits every occurrence as ordinary canonical JSON. The worker compares each emitted byte with the original, including the declared final newline. It rereads the saved table before the independent comparison. A small materialization test also checks that repeated references become distinct mutable containers when a caller requests ordinary data.

The fragment payload is limited to \(8.00\,\mathrm{MiB}\) and \(65,536\) entries, with fragments no larger than \(4,096\) bytes and stream chunks no larger than \(65,536\) bytes. Cache payload bounds exclude Python object overhead; the full worker peak includes it. Callback tests cover cached construction and post-first-chunk copies, not every possible completion/fallback interruption. Bounded builtin scans/copies still rely on Python/OS latency assumptions; no continuous formal time seal is claimed.

The finite domain is explicit: builtin JSON containers and scalars, Unicode scalar strings, finite Python floats with canonical spelling, and bounded sizes/depth/work. Boolean values and integers remain different node types; signed floating zero is retained. Duplicate keys, malformed references and cycles are rejected. Initial exclusive ownership and the pinned Python/stdlib/OS remain trusted assumptions.

A limitation found in the earlier implementation

Source review found that a delegated StopIteration raised inside the old generator-based encoder or inverse becomes RuntimeError, with the original exception as its cause. This follows the documented Python exception behavior and PEP 479. The older \(71\) diagnostics did not test that exception. Their measured byte comparisons and finite outcomes remain valid; a general claim of preserving every callback exception unchanged was too broad.

The new \(23\) forest cases include selected StopIteration, GeneratorExit, SystemExit and other callback markers at preparation, after the first chunk and at completion. The current selector shows their literal returned packets when they completed. The legacy finding itself was established by Source review, without a new runtime replay of the old paths.

The first two trials ran whole inputs before diagnostics. Both fragment trials run the same full suite first, then all three original whole inputs. Every earlier trial has a fresh once-only subject and starts from the original files; no failed output table or cache is reused.
The fragment inverse uses a new explicit actual-operation accounting profile. The earlier inverse charged a virtual occurrence walk. These units are different. Within the new profile, the first whole input needs \(20,354,563\) charged operations. The default \(20,000,000\) trial therefore remains UNKNOWN. Only the separately declared \(30,000,000\) guard qualifies. The inverse module’s default stays unchanged; no proof-search or Native budget changes.
The first timeout is censored, the inverse/accounting and diagnostic order changed, and the successful trial explicitly changes a private guard. These four earlier measurements do not establish a causal speedup. The earlier successful first-input cache records \(2,265,677\) stream hits, \(54,402\) entries and \(1.70\,\mathrm{MiB}\) payload, all charged in the worker peak. A hit alone is not a measured net performance benefit.
Terminal time starts at the runner’s timestamp immediately after importing time. Runner interpreter startup and the outer observer prelude precede this gated epoch. Positive work includes component imports, input setup, every diagnostic and known worker exit. The observer deadline is failure-only and grants no extra positive work.


The numeric limits are \(180\,\mathrm{s}\) for positive work and known worker exit, \(210\,\mathrm{s}\) for the observed terminal, \(1\,\mathrm{GiB}\) for the worker peak, and \(128\,\mathrm{MiB}\) each for aggregate encoded outputs and expanded input data. All input parsing, interning, validation, full inverses, fixtures, writes and custody checks are charged. No Native process exists in this specialized profile.


The inputs are processed serially. Each ordinary parsed object is released after freezing, while its raw bytes, immutable table and later wire/validation lifetimes remain charged. The measurement excludes the outer observer/controller. It does not replicate the lifetime of a live candidate graph or scientific search, so it cannot establish a reduction in integrated GCTS memory.


Compact bytes and expanded bytes are separate quantities. A future compact file below the numeric limit cannot be called success under the old full-JSON serialization guard if its expanded old JSON exceeds that guard. Any changed interpretation requires a clearly declared representation profile.
The fifth trial changes both representation and diagnostic set. Its main arena has one invocation-total weighted attempted-work guard of \(200,000,000\); the independent forest has a new actual-operation guard of \(30,000,000\) across preparation and every document stream. These units are not the earlier single-root inverse units. Diagnostic instances have separate finite local caps, but every constructor and fixture remains inside the common worker time and peak. Full Source hashing, copy-on-write bookkeeping, parse/capture/seal/export, saved-file reread and reconstruction are included. No causal speedup or RAM reduction follows from comparing these different trials.
